name: v1.6.4
body:
## 10/02/2026

### Changed

- Updated Claude Code to 2.1.287, OpenAI Codex to 0.160.0, and Junie to 3419.26.
- Pinned Debian Chromium 154.0.8037.92 for AMD64 and ARM64. Updated the application Python runtime to 3.14.8 and Wrangler to 4.146.0 in the Full image.
- Updated Azure CLI's bundled PyJWT to 2.15.1 and urllib3 to 2.8.0.

### Security

- CoderLuii accepted the exact known Critical and High findings in the four v1.6.4 images through October 4, 2026. This includes findings in HolyClaude's custom FFmpeg build and bundled tools, not only Debian packages. The findings are still present; acceptance does not mean they are fixed or harmless. The [accepted-risk manifest](https://github.com/CoderLuii/HolyClaude/blob/v1.6.4/security/v1.6.4-accepted-risk.json) and [scan evidence](https://github.com/CoderLuii/HolyClaude/actions/runs/36969625058) record their scope. New or changed findings still block publication.
